positions.title: Team Lead
positions.description:
• Maintained and developed the bidding infrastructure and tracking tools of real-time media buying platform receiving more than 1 million requests per second
• Coded, deployed, and monitored 2 applications (Play, Rails) running on dozens of AWS servers
• Designed and implemented a system for incorporating native ads in the platform
• Managed 3 engineers, including leading meetings and writing technical specs for team projects
• Responsible for integration and testing with 4 supply-side ad platforms

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Acted as a resource for students in data structures classes taught in Java
• Facilitated understanding of programming concepts and strategies
• Hosted weekly working sessions for student programming assignments

company.name: Department of Computer Science, Williams College

positions.title: Biostatistics Intern
positions.description:
• Managed the data systems for 8 clinical trials
• Automated the clinical trial data reporting process via SAS code to generate calculations and output for study analysis

positions.title: Undergraduate Summer Intern
positions.description:
• Developed an application for visualizing results from genome sequencing experiments
• Processed and graphed genome analysis pipeline using R and JavaScript

Software Release:
Hector Corrada Bravo, Llewellyn Smith, Naomi Goldstein, and Florin Chelaru. epivizr: R interface to epiviz visualization tool. R package version 1.0.0.
